row.evidence: Pigment's SSO documentation says "SSO is available on all Pigment tiers" but "You will need the correct Pigment tier for SCIM"; plans are only available from a Customer Success Manager.
row.notes: Quote-only: Pigment publishes no plans or prices (pigment.com/pricing is 404; licence docs say to contact your Customer Success Manager), and SCIM needs "the correct Pigment tier", so SCIM is gated at an unnamed tier. SAML SSO is on all tiers (set up with Pigment Support) and is a prerequisite for SCIM. SCIM 2.0 Users only: create, read by email/id, PUT and limited PATCH, deactivate/reactivate; DELETE suspends rather than removes; no groups or app roles; accountType extension sets the workspace account type. No Okta OIN app; Okta, Entra and OneLogin are configured as custom SCIM apps with a workspace token (admin-chosen expiry). Read-only Audit Logs API available to Security Admins.

plans.notes: SSO on all tiers; SCIM only on an unnamed eligible tier.

scim.plan: SCIM-eligible Pigment tier (plans not published; Contact Sales)

auth.token_source: Workspace Settings > Members management > More options > Identity & provisioning settings > SCIM Provisioning > + Add token
auth.notes: Okta set-up uses an HTTP Header authorization with the token; OneLogin and Entra use it as a bearer/secret token. Tokens belong to the workspace and survive the creator's deactivation; several can be active for rotation.

operations.notes: DELETE is accepted but suspends the user instead of removing them.

deprovision.data_retained: User is suspended, not removed, and can be restored; deactivated Members' contributions stay in the history log.

custom.how: accountType (Standard Member, Builder, Workspace Admin, Security Admin) in urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:pigment:2.0:User

roles.how: accountType extension attribute sets the workspace account type; application roles and Pigment groups are not provisioned.

limitations.text: No provisioning of Pigment user groups or application roles.
With SCIM on, members can no longer be invited or deactivated manually in Pigment.
Primary Owner cannot be deactivated or assigned via SCIM.
Email changes only via full PUT; PATCH on emails (as Entra sends) is not supported.
No Okta Integration Network app; Okta, OneLogin and Entra are configured manually as custom SCIM apps.
SAML SSO must already be configured (set up with Pigment Support) before SCIM.
Pigment's public API covers imports, exports, metadata, files and audit logs; no user-management endpoints are documented outside SCIM.

okta.notes: No OIN app; SCIM enabled manually on the customer's own Pigment SAML 2.0 app.

entra.notes: Configured as a non-gallery "Create your own application" enterprise app.

onelogin.notes: Configured with the generic "SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Core)" app.
